Privacy Policy – AI Folders

Last updated: July 2026

Our philosophy on privacy is simple: we do not collect, sell or analyze any of your personal data. Here is how we operate, in full transparency:

1. On the website (aifolders.xyz)

Anonymous visit counts

This site counts visits with GoatCounter, an open-source analytics service that respects privacy: no cookies, no pixels and no personal data. Only the page viewed, the referring site, the browser, the operating system, the screen size and the approximate country are recorded; your IP address is not stored.

Language preference

We only use your browser's local storage (localStorage) to remember your language preference. This small text entry is strictly functional, never leaves your device and is never used to identify you.

Uninstall feedback page

When you remove one of the extensions, your browser opens a short feedback page on this site. Its address carries six non-identifying details: how long the extension was installed, its version, your browser, your interface language, how many times you opened the popup, and how many conversations you saved. Neither those details nor your answers leave your device unless you choose to submit the form, which is optional and anonymous. Submitted answers are collected through Google Forms.

2. In the AI Folders and Gemini Folders extensions

Zero telemetry

The extensions contain no hidden code designed to track your behavior, your clicks or the sites you visit.

Data storage

Everything you create (your folder structure, the titles and links of the conversations you save, and the prompts in your library) is stored using your browser's own sync (Chrome Sync on Chrome, Firefox Sync on Firefox) and kept in step across your signed-in devices through that official infrastructure. The extension only ever records a conversation's title and link, never the content of the conversation itself.

Optional mobile sync

When you turn on mobile sync, the extension mirrors your folder structure (folder names, conversation titles and links) into your browser's bookmarks, so you can reach it from your phone. This is the only feature that writes your data outside the extension's own storage; it stays entirely within your personal browser account, it is off by default, and you can switch it off at any time.

Optional local AI models

If you connect a local AI model, the address you enter stays on your device and is used only to talk to that model directly. The extension asks for access to that single address, nothing wider, and only when you add it.

No third-party servers

Your data never passes through our servers, quite simply because we have no servers dedicated to collecting data. The tools are open source and auditable by anyone.

3. Updates

If the way we handle data ever changes (for example, if we added a feature requiring new permissions), this policy will be updated and, where the law requires it, we will ask for your prior consent.

4. Contact us

For any question about this policy or to review the extension's source code, you can visit our GitHub repository and contact us at: https://github.com/dlamarre-dev/AI-Gemini-Folders
